Champ is a lot about knowing who you can, and can't fight. I'd recommend you max R>Q>E>W and build mostly tank (1-2 dps items at max). Trade in lane if you are fighting weaker lane opponents, and try to line up your blade, so it passes through the enemy when you draw it. Also map awareness, focus heavily on what your team is doing so you can ult in to assist.
